propositions: A new NDJSON snapshot store at `.rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson` must persist point-in-time code-health metrics (coverage %, complexity distribution, clone count) across CI runs.
The `write_snapshot(dict)` function appends timestamped records to the NDJSON file and `read_snapshots(since, until)` yields filtered records in the date range.
The snapshot file must be surgically un-ignored in `.gitignore` with `!.rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson` to override the blanket `.rebar/*` rule and ensure persistence via git commit.
Malformed or truncated NDJSON lines are silently skipped during read without raising exceptions, and valid records are returned.
Unit tests round-trip snapshots through write and read, verify range filtering excludes out-of-range records, and confirm the store is not matched by repo gitignore rules.
